verses.en: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
verses.pt: Pelo que, santos irmãos, participantes da vocação celestial, considerai o Apóstolo e Sumo Sacerdote da nossa confissão, Jesus,
verses.en_web: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Jesus;
verses.en_bbe: For this reason, holy brothers, marked out to have a part in heaven, give thought to Jesus the representative and high priest of our faith;

verses.en: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
verses.pt: como ele foi fiel ao que o constituiu, assim como também o foi Moisés em toda a casa de Deus.
verses.en_web: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.
verses.en_bbe: Who kept faith with God who gave him his place, even as Moses did in all his house.

verses.en: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
verses.pt: Pois ele é tido por digno de tanto maior glória do que Moisés, quanto maior honra do que a casa tem aquele que a edificou.
verses.en_web: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.
verses.en_bbe: And it was right for this man to have more honour than Moses, even as the builder of a house has more honour than the house.

verses.en: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.
verses.pt: Porque toda casa é edificada por alguém, mas quem edificou todas as coisas é Deus.
verses.en_web: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.
verses.en_bbe: For every house has a builder; but the builder of all things is God.

verses.en: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
verses.pt: Moisés, na verdade, foi fiel em toda a casa de Deus, como servo, para testemunho das coisas que se haviam de anunciar;
verses.en_web: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,
verses.en_bbe: And Moses certainly kept faith as a servant, in all his house, and as a witness of those things which were to be said later;

verses.en: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
verses.pt: mas Cristo o é como Filho sobre a casa de Deus; a qual casa somos nós, se tão-somente conservarmos firmes até o fim a nossa confiança e a glória da esperança.
verses.en_web: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house; whose house we are, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.
verses.en_bbe: But Christ as a son, over his house; whose house are we, if we keep our hearts fixed in the glad and certain hope till the end.

verses.en: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.pt: Pelo que, como diz o Espírito Santo: Hoje, se ouvirdes a sua voz,
verses.en_web: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
verses.en_bbe: And so, as the Holy Spirit says, Today if you let his voice come to your ears,

verses.en: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.pt: não endureçais os vossos corações, como na provocação, no dia da tentação no deserto,
verses.en_web: don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
verses.en_bbe: Be not hard of heart, as when you made me angry, on the day of testing in the waste land,

verses.en: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
verses.pt: onde vossos pais me tentaram, pondo-me à prova, e viram por quarenta anos as minhas obras.
verses.en_web: where your fathers tested me by proving me, and saw my deeds for forty years.
verses.en_bbe: When your fathers put me to the test, and saw my works for forty years.

verses.en: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
verses.pt: Por isto me indignei contra essa geração, e disse: Estes sempre erram em seu coração, e não chegaram a conhecer os meus caminhos.
verses.en_web: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways;’
verses.en_bbe: So that I was angry with this generation, and I said, Their hearts are in error at all times, and they have no knowledge of my ways;

verses.en: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
verses.pt: Assim jurei na minha ira: Não entrarão no meu descanso.
verses.en_web: as I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”
verses.en_bbe: And being angry I made an oath, saying, They may not come into my rest.

verses.en: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
verses.pt: Vede, irmãos, que nunca se ache em qualquer de vós um perverso coração de incredulidade, para se apartar do Deus vivo;
verses.en_web: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;
verses.en_bbe: My brothers, take care that there is not by chance in any one of you an evil heart without belief, turning away from the living God:

verses.en: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.pt: antes exortai-vos uns aos outros todos os dias, durante o tempo que se chama Hoje, para que nenhum de vós se endureça pelo engano do pecado;
verses.en_web: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.en_bbe: But give comfort to one another every day as long as it is still Today; so that no one among you may be made hard by the deceit of sin:

verses.en: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
verses.pt: porque nos temos tornado participantes de Cristo, se é que guardamos firme até o fim a nossa confiança inicial;
verses.en_web: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold fast the beginning of our confidence firm to the end:
verses.en_bbe: For if we keep the substance of the faith which we had at the start, even till the end, we have a part with Christ;

verses.en: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
verses.pt: enquanto se diz: Hoje, se ouvirdes a sua voz, não endureçais os vossos corações, como na provocação;
verses.en_web: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”
verses.en_bbe: As it is said, Today if you will let his voice come to your ears, be not hard of heart, as when you made him angry.

verses.en: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
verses.pt: pois quais os que, tendo-a ouvido, o provocaram? Não foram, porventura, todos os que saíram do Egito por meio de Moisés?
verses.en_web: For who, when they heard, rebelled? No, didn’t all those who came out of Egypt by Moses?
verses.en_bbe: Who made him angry when his voice came to them? was it not all those who came out of Egypt with Moses?

verses.en: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
verses.pt: E contra quem se indignou por quarenta anos? Não foi porventura contra os que pecaram, cujos corpos caíram no deserto?
verses.en_web: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
verses.en_bbe: And with whom was he angry for forty years? was it not with those who did evil, who came to their deaths in the waste land?

verses.en: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
verses.pt: E a quem jurou que não entrariam no seu descanso, senão aos que foram desobedientes?
verses.en_web: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
verses.en_bbe: And to whom did he make an oath that they might not come into his rest? was it not to those who went against his orders?

verses.en: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
verses.pt: E vemos que não puderam entrar por causa da incredulidade.
verses.en_web: We see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.
verses.en_bbe: So we see that they were not able to go in because they had no belief.
